gloss: to come back to life; to revive; to make a comeback

definitions.gloss: to regain consciousness; to come back to life
definitions.explanation: Literally, to start breathing again. Used when someone who appeared dead or unconscious recovers.

definitions.gloss: to revive; to make a comeback; to bounce back
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, for something that seemed finished or defeated to regain strength and activity. Used for businesses, teams, economies, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The patient came back to life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心肺|しんぱい}{蘇生|そせい}→心肺蘇生：29912_shinpaisosei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to CPR, the person was able to be revived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧⟦{寸前|すんぜん}→寸前：12356_sunzen⟧だった⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The company that was once on the verge of bankruptcy made a comeback.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: The team came alive in the second half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: After a long recession, the shopping street in this town is finally coming back to life.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (sense 1) is used in medical and emergency contexts. The figurative meaning (sense 2) is more common in everyday speech and news, describing revivals and comebacks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}す (to come back to life / to revive)
- ようやく{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}す (to finally revive)
- ⟦{奇跡|きせき}{的|てき}→奇跡的：28181_kisekiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}す (to miraculously come back to life)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蘇|よみがえ}る→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧: to be resurrected, to revive — a single verb with similar meaning
- ⟦{復活|ふっかつ}→復活：12565_fukkatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a comeback — more commonly used for careers or products
